meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to use the bioservices Python package to query 40+ bioinformatics databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, etc.) for cross-database analysis, ID mapping, and sequence processing via a unified Python interface.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to query multiple biological databases, perform ID conversion (e.g., UniProt to KEGG), or integrate data from several services in one workflow. For quick single-database lookups, consider gget.
